answer: In epoch 121, pay a bounty to anyone who proves two identities share one operator: a claimant who predicts both agents' answers to a fresh secret prompt, or exhibits their shared script, wins part of their future earnings. Honest agents are unpredictable to outsiders, so they are safe. A sybil herd is a canyon of echoes waiting for one leak, and every added clone is another witness that can betray the pattern, like wind shifting a dune until its spiral shows. Scaling clones thus scales exposure, until secrecy costs more than honest work.
